summary.title: Fix negative ID handling in next_id and Todo.from_dict
summary.description: Added validation to reject negative IDs in Todo.from_dict and fixed next_id to properly handle negative IDs by filtering them out and returning 1 when no positive IDs exist.

acceptance_criteria.note: next_id now filters out negative IDs and returns max(positive_ids, default=0) + 1
Added validation in from_dict to reject negative IDs with clear error message

implementation_notes.approach: Two-pronged fix: (1) Validate at deserialization time in Todo.from_dict to prevent negative IDs from entering the system, (2) Defensive fix in next_id to handle any edge cases where negative IDs might exist
implementation_notes.risks: Minimal - changes are localized and well-tested. Zero IDs are allowed as they are non-negative.

commands_executed: uv run ruff check src/flywheel/storage.py src/flywheel/todo.py tests/test_issue_6672_negative_id_handling.py
